title: Layout Skeleton
description: Skeleton definition for one layout under a template. Lists the named slots the layout exposes, their kinds, optional bounds, and the controlled render primitive each slot maps to. A slot's primitive_kind (when set) is the only render_model primitive kind allowed for a render_model primitive whose slot_id targets this slot.

name.description: Layout id. Must match the filename and an entry in the template's layouts list.

bounds.description: Optional axis-aligned bounding box, in canvas pixels relative to the same grid as design_system.grid. When set, render_model primitives whose slot_id targets this slot must keep their own bounds inside it. Optional today so existing layouts continue to validate; the renderer will require it once SVG/PPTX export comes online.

primitive_kind.description: Optional explicit mapping from this slot to a render_model primitive kind. When unset, validators fall back to the default slot.type -> primitive.kind table documented in references/slide-contracts.md (text/list/callout -> text, kpi -> kpi, table -> table, image_ref -> image_slot, chart_ref -> chart_placeholder).
